extends RefCounted
## Unified damage event for every dealing layer: pilot gun, MG turret, CC turret,
## future mech rotary/rockets, enemies, Core. Receivers participate via the
## duck-typed take_damage(event) method. Host-authoritative; no ability system.


enum Source { PILOT_GUN, MG_TURRET, CC_TURRET, MECH_ROTARY, MECH_ROCKET, ENEMY, OTHER }

const NAMES := ["pilot_gun", "mg_turret", "cc_turret", "mech_rotary", "mech_rocket", "enemy", "other"]

var amount := 0.0
var source: int = Source.OTHER
var source_id := 0
var hit_pos := Vector3.ZERO
var weakpoint := false


func _init(p_amount := 0.0, p_source: int = Source.OTHER, p_source_id := 0,
		p_hit_pos := Vector3.ZERO, p_weakpoint := false) -> void:
	amount = p_amount
	source = p_source
	source_id = p_source_id
	hit_pos = p_hit_pos
	weakpoint = p_weakpoint


static func apply(target, event) -> bool:
	if target != null and is_instance_valid(target) and target.has_method("take_damage"):
		target.take_damage(event)
		return true
	return false


func source_name() -> String:
	return NAMES[clampi(source, 0, NAMES.size() - 1)]

extends "res://combat/src/enemies/enemy_base.gd"
## Armored / weak-point: heavy hover tank with one glowing orange weak-point orb.
## Shell shrugs off MG fire (and mostly pilot body shots); the orb takes bonus
## damage but must be aimed at deliberately — this is the pilot-attention test.

const ModelLib := preload("res://combat/src/visuals/model_lib.gd")

var _siege_accum := 0.0
var _wp: Node3D = null
var _in_siege := false


func cc_state() -> String:
	return "armored_siege" if _in_siege else "armored_walk"


func weakpoint_pos() -> Vector3:
	return _wp.global_position if _wp != null else global_position + Vector3.UP * 1.5


func _init() -> void:
	role = Role.ARMORED


func _ready() -> void:
	max_hp = stats.armored_hp
	hp = max_hp
	speed = stats.armored_speed
	target = core
	add_to_group("enemies")
	Metrics.inst().spawned_by_role["armored"] += 1

	var size := Vector3(1.6, 1.6, 1.6)
	if not ModelLib.attach_sized(self, "SM_Veh_HoverTank_01.fbx",
			Color(0.16, 0.16, 0.2), Vector3.ZERO, 3.6):
		var mesh := MeshInstance3D.new()
		var box := BoxMesh.new()
		box.size = size
		mesh.mesh = box
		mesh.position.y = 0.9
		var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
		m.albedo_color = Color(0.16, 0.16, 0.2)
		m.metallic = 0.6
		m.roughness = 0.35
		mesh.material_override = m
		add_child(mesh)

	var cs := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var shape := BoxShape3D.new()
	shape.size = size
	cs.shape = shape
	cs.position.y = 0.9
	add_child(cs)

	var wp := StaticBody3D.new()
	wp.add_to_group("weakpoint")
	wp.collision_layer = 4
	wp.collision_mask = 0
	var wcs := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var ws := SphereShape3D.new()
	ws.radius = 0.3
	wcs.shape = ws
	wp.add_child(wcs)
	wp.position = Vector3(0.85, 1.5, 0.85)
	var wm := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var wmesh := SphereMesh.new()
	wmesh.radius = 0.3
	wmesh.height = 0.6
	wm.mesh = wmesh
	var wmat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	wmat.albedo_color = Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.05)
	wmat.emission_enabled = true
	wmat.emission = Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.0)
	wmat.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.0
	wm.material_override = wmat
	wp.add_child(wm)
	add_child(wp)
	_wp = wp


func _combat_behaviour(dist: float, dt: float) -> bool:
	if try_melee(dt, stats.armored_melee_range,
			stats.armored_melee_damage, stats.armored_melee_interval):
		velocity = Vector3.ZERO
		_in_siege = false
		return true
	_in_siege = dist <= 3.6
	if _in_siege:
		velocity = Vector3.ZERO
		if core != null and is_instance_valid(core):
			_siege_accum += dt * stats.armored_siege_dps * slow_factor
			if _siege_accum >= 1.0:
				var dmg := floorf(_siege_accum)
				_siege_accum -= dmg
				core.take_damage(DamageEvent.new(dmg, DamageEvent.Source.ENEMY, get_instance_id()))
		return true
	return false

extends Node3D
## Harasser projectile: slow, dodgeable orb fired from standoff range.
## Distance-checked against its victim; no physics body needed at lab scale.

const DamageEvent := preload("res://combat/src/combat/damage_contract.gd")
const Metrics := preload("res://combat/src/metrics/combat_metrics.gd")
const Stats := preload("res://combat/data/combat_stats.gd")

const SPEED := 14.0
const LIFE := 4.0
const HIT_RADIUS := 1.1

var victim: Node3D = null
var dir := Vector3.ZERO
var _life := LIFE


func launch(from: Vector3, p_victim: Node3D) -> void:
	global_position = from
	victim = p_victim
	dir = (p_victim.global_position + Vector3.UP * 0.9 - from).normalized()
	var mesh := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var s := SphereMesh.new()
	s.radius = 0.22
	s.height = 0.44
	mesh.mesh = s
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color(0.75, 0.3, 0.95)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = Color(0.4, 0.05, 0.6)
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.0
	mesh.material_override = m
	add_child(mesh)


func _physics_process(dt: float) -> void:
	_life -= dt
	if _life <= 0.0:
		queue_free()
		return
	global_position += dir * SPEED * dt
	if victim != null and is_instance_valid(victim):
		var hit_pos := victim.global_position + Vector3.UP * 0.9
		if global_position.distance_to(hit_pos) <= HIT_RADIUS:
			DamageEvent.apply(victim, DamageEvent.new(Stats.ensure().harasser_proj_damage,
					DamageEvent.Source.ENEMY, get_instance_id(), hit_pos))
			queue_free()

extends RefCounted
## Lab-local combat instrumentation. Every damage/kill/ammo/control event funnels
## here; scenarios dump JSON snapshots into results/. Static holder so it works
## both in the running game and under --script headless tests.

const DamageEvent := preload("res://combat/src/combat/damage_contract.gd")

static var I = null
## VS5-T4: recorded RNG seed shared by all scenario dumps.
const SEED := 20260825


static func inst():
	if I == null:
		I = load("res://combat/src/metrics/combat_metrics.gd").new()
	return I


static func reset_all() -> void:
	I = null


var elapsed := 0.0
var label := "play"
var core_hp := 1000.0
var core_max := 1000.0
var spawned_by_role := {"pressure": 0, "armored": 0, "harasser": 0}
var kills_by_source := {}
var kills_of_role := {}
var damage_by_source := {}
var damage_to_role := {}
var shots := {}
var ammo_spent := {}
var ammo_remaining := {"mg": 0, "cc": 0}
var cc_uptime := 0.0
var cc_applications := 0
var cc_apps_by_state := {}
var leak_times: Array = []
var ferry_seconds := 0.0
var core_damage_during_ferry := 0.0
var leaks_during_ferry := 0
var leaks := 0
var core_damage_taken := 0.0
var supply_trips := 0
var packs_delivered := 0
var pilot_deaths := 0
var priority_kills_by_pilot := 0
var turrets_destroyed := 0
var outcome := "incomplete"
var timeline: Array = []
var _timeline_accum := 0.0


func reset(p_label: String) -> void:
	label = p_label
	elapsed = 0.0
	kills_by_source = {}
	kills_of_role = {}
	damage_by_source = {}
	damage_to_role = {}
	shots = {}
	ammo_spent = {}
	cc_uptime = 0.0
	cc_applications = 0
	cc_apps_by_state = {}
	leak_times = []
	ferry_seconds = 0.0
	core_damage_during_ferry = 0.0
	leaks_during_ferry = 0
	leaks = 0
	core_damage_taken = 0.0
	supply_trips = 0
	packs_delivered = 0
	pilot_deaths = 0
	priority_kills_by_pilot = 0
	turrets_destroyed = 0
	outcome = "incomplete"
	timeline = []
	_timeline_accum = 0.0


func log_damage(evt, victim_role: String, effective_amount: float) -> void:
	var key: String = evt.source_name() if evt is DamageEvent else str(evt)
	damage_by_source[key] = damage_by_source.get(key, 0.0) + evt.amount
	damage_to_role[victim_role] = damage_to_role.get(victim_role, 0.0) + effective_amount


func log_kill(source_name: String, victim_role: String) -> void:
	kills_by_source[source_name] = kills_by_source.get(source_name, 0) + 1
	kills_of_role[victim_role] = kills_of_role.get(victim_role, 0) + 1


func log_shot(kind: String) -> void:
	shots[kind] = shots.get(kind, 0) + 1


func log_ammo_spent(kind: String, n: int) -> void:
	ammo_spent[kind] = ammo_spent.get(kind, 0) + n


func add_cc_time(dt: float) -> void:
	cc_uptime += dt


func cc_applied() -> void:
	cc_applications += 1


func leak() -> void:
	leaks += 1
	leak_times.append(snappedf(elapsed, 0.1))


func supply_trip() -> void:
	supply_trips += 1


func pack_delivered(n: int) -> void:
	packs_delivered += n


func pilot_death() -> void:
	pilot_deaths += 1


func priority_kill() -> void:
	priority_kills_by_pilot += 1


func turret_destroyed() -> void:
	turrets_destroyed += 1


func tick(dt: float, alive_total: int = 0) -> void:
	elapsed += dt
	_timeline_accum += dt
	if _timeline_accum >= 2.0:
		_timeline_accum = 0.0
		timeline.append([snappedf(elapsed, 0.1), snappedf(core_hp / maxf(core_max, 1.0), 0.01), alive_total])


func dump(path: String) -> Dictionary:
	var d := {
		"seed": SEED,
		"label": label,
		"elapsed_sec": snappedf(elapsed, 0.1),
		"outcome": outcome,
		"core_hp_frac": snappedf(core_hp / maxf(core_max, 1.0), 0.001),
		"damage_by_source": damage_by_source,
		"kills_by_source": kills_by_source,
		"kills_of_role": kills_of_role,
		"damage_to_role": damage_to_role,
		"shots": shots,
		"ammo_spent": ammo_spent,
		"ammo_remaining": ammo_remaining,
		"cc_uptime_sec": snappedf(cc_uptime, 0.1),
		"cc_applications": cc_applications,
		"cc_apps_by_state": cc_apps_by_state,
		"leak_times": leak_times,
		"ferry_seconds": snappedf(ferry_seconds, 0.1),
		"core_damage_during_ferry": core_damage_during_ferry,
		"leaks_during_ferry": leaks_during_ferry,
		"enemy_leaks": leaks,
		"supply_trips": supply_trips,
		"packs_delivered": packs_delivered,
		"pilot_deaths": pilot_deaths,
		"priority_kills_by_pilot": priority_kills_by_pilot,
		"turrets_destroyed": turrets_destroyed,
		"spawned_by_role": spawned_by_role,
		"timeline_2s": timeline,
	}
	var f := FileAccess.open(path, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if f != null:
		f.store_string(JSON.stringify(d, "  "))
		f.close()
	print(summary())
	return d


func summary() -> String:
	var lines := ["=== %s | %.1fs | %s ===" % [label.to_upper(), elapsed, outcome.to_upper()]]
	lines.append("core %.0f%% | leaks %d | cc_uptime %.1fs/%d apps | trips %d | packs %d | pilot_deaths %d | prio_kills %d" % [
		core_hp / maxf(core_max, 1.0) * 100.0, leaks, cc_uptime, cc_applications,
		supply_trips, packs_delivered, pilot_deaths, priority_kills_by_pilot])
	lines.append("damage by source: " + str(damage_by_source))
	lines.append("kills by source: " + str(kills_by_source))
	return "\n".join(lines)

extends Node
## Device adapter: polls physical keys/mouse into a PilotCommand each tick.
## Only this file knows about hardware; swap for rebinding or remote play
## without touching motor, autopilot or netcode paths.

const ActorCommand := preload("res://actor/actor_command.gd")

var _yaw_pending := 0.0
var _pitch_pending := 0.0
var _prev_jump := false
var _prev_dodge := false
var _prev_interact := false


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseMotion and Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
		_yaw_pending += event.relative.x
		_pitch_pending += event.relative.y
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed \
			and Input.mouse_mode != Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
		capture_mouse()


func poll() -> ActorCommand:
	var cmd := ActorCommand.new()
	cmd.mv = Vector2(_axis(KEY_D, KEY_A), -_axis(KEY_W, KEY_S)) # canon: y back-positive
	var jump := Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_SPACE)
	var dodge := Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT)
	var interact := Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_E)
	cmd.jump = jump and not _prev_jump
	cmd.dodge = dodge and not _prev_dodge
	cmd.interact = interact and not _prev_interact
	_prev_jump = jump
	_prev_dodge = dodge
	_prev_interact = interact
	cmd.fire_p = Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)
	# Legacy pixel-delta emission: exact pre-VS5-T7 behavior.
	# mouse-y is screen-down; canon look.y positive = pitch up
	cmd.yaw_delta = _yaw_pending
	cmd.pitch_delta = _pitch_pending
	_yaw_pending = 0.0
	_pitch_pending = 0.0
	return cmd


func capture_mouse() -> void:
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED


func release_mouse() -> void:
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE


func _axis(pos: Key, neg: Key) -> float:
	var v := 0.0
	if Input.is_physical_key_pressed(pos):
		v += 1.0
	if Input.is_physical_key_pressed(neg):
		v -= 1.0
	return v

extends RefCounted
## Pure kinematic pilot step: PilotState x PilotCommand x dt -> mutated state.
## No scene-tree access, fully deterministic. Collision resolution is owned by
## the caller (host physics body), keeping this replappable/predictable.
##
## Donor provenance (see README): accel/decel model adapted from official
## godot-demo-projects 3d/platformer player.gd; dodge = GDQuest melee-lunge
## impulse shape with a tick timer; aim geometry from GDQuest crosshair ray.


const MAX_SPEED := 7.0
const ACCEL := 45.0
const DECEL := 60.0
const GRAVITY := 26.0
const JUMP_SPEED := 8.8
const DODGE_SPEED := 15.0
const DODGE_TIME := 0.22
const DODGE_COOLDOWN := 1.6
## VS5-T7: look sensitivity lives in ActorCommand.INPUT_LOOK_SENSITIVITY;


static func forward(yaw: float) -> Vector3:
	return Vector3(-sin(yaw), 0.0, -cos(yaw))


static func right(yaw: float) -> Vector3:
	return Vector3(cos(yaw), 0.0, -sin(yaw))


static func wish_dir(s, c) -> Vector3:
	var w: Vector3 = right(s.yaw) * c.mv.x + forward(s.yaw) * -c.mv.y # canon mv: y back-positive
	w.y = 0.0
	return w.limit_length(1.0)


static func yaw_toward(from_yaw: float, dir: Vector3) -> float:
	return wrapf(atan2(-dir.x, -dir.z), -PI, PI)


static func step(s, c, dt: float, integrate := true) -> void:
	# Legacy pixel path (pilot stack parity) + canon rate path (mech/netcode).
	s.yaw = wrapf(s.yaw - c.yaw_delta * 0.0026 + c.look.x * dt, -PI, PI)
	s.pitch = clampf(s.pitch - c.pitch_delta * 0.0026 + c.look.y * dt, -1.2, 1.2)
	s.dodge_cd = maxf(0.0, s.dodge_cd - dt)
	s.fire_cd = maxf(0.0, s.fire_cd - dt)

	if c.dodge and s.dodge_cd <= 0.0 and s.grounded:
		var dd := wish_dir(s, c)
		if dd == Vector3.ZERO:
			dd = forward(s.yaw)
		s.velocity.x = dd.x * DODGE_SPEED
		s.velocity.z = dd.z * DODGE_SPEED
		s.dodge_left = DODGE_TIME
		s.dodge_cd = DODGE_COOLDOWN

	if s.dodge_left > 0.0:
		s.dodge_left -= dt
	else:
		var w := wish_dir(s, c)
		var target := w * MAX_SPEED
		var hv := Vector3(s.velocity.x, 0.0, s.velocity.z)
		var rate := ACCEL if w != Vector3.ZERO else DECEL
		hv = hv.move_toward(target, rate * dt)
		s.velocity.x = hv.x
		s.velocity.z = hv.z

	s.velocity.y -= GRAVITY * dt

	if c.jump and s.grounded:
		s.velocity.y = JUMP_SPEED
		s.grounded = false

	s.position += s.velocity * dt


static func integrate_only(s, dt: float) -> void:
	s.position += s.velocity * dt

extends Node3D
## Production pilot presentation recovered from VS-5 combat and the locomotion
## lab. Reads PlayerAvatar only; it owns no gameplay truth.

const ModelLib := preload("res://combat/src/visuals/model_lib.gd")
const PilotNativeAnim := preload("res://combat/src/pilot/pilot_native_anim.gd")

const PILOT_COLOR := Color(0.42, 0.60, 0.72)
const DARK := Color(0.12, 0.14, 0.17)
const AMBER := Color(1.0, 0.69, 0.0)

# Shared camera geometry. PlayerAvatar reconstructs the same ray on the host so
# authoritative packed-crowd hits stay aligned with the screen-center crosshair
# without making gameplay depend on this presentation node.
const CAMERA_PIVOT_HEIGHT := 1.58
const CAMERA_SHOULDER_X := 0.48
const CAMERA_FREE_LENGTH := 4.0
const CAMERA_AIM_LENGTH := 2.35
const CAMERA_MARGIN := 0.25

var local_view := false
var camera: Camera3D = null
var _pivot: Node3D = null
var _arm: SpringArm3D = null
var _pack: MeshInstance3D = null
var _crosshair: ColorRect = null
var _dmg_flash: ColorRect = null
var _native: Node3D = null
var _visual_root: Node3D = null
var _left_leg: Node3D = null
var _right_leg: Node3D = null
var _left_arm: Node3D = null
var _right_arm: Node3D = null
var _anim_t := 0.0


func setup(body_rid: RID, p_local_view: bool) -> void:
	local_view = p_local_view
	if _arm != null:
		_arm.add_excluded_object(body_rid)
	set_local_camera_active(local_view)


func _ready() -> void:
	_visual_root = Node3D.new()
	_visual_root.name = "PilotVisual"
	add_child(_visual_root)

	_native = PilotNativeAnim.new()
	_native.name = "NativeAnimationBackend"
	_visual_root.add_child(_native)
	var animated := _native.try_setup()
	if not animated:
		if not _attach_synty_static():
			_build_biped_fallback()

	_build_weapon()
	_build_pack()
	_build_camera()
	if local_view:
		_build_screen_feedback()


func _attach_synty_static() -> bool:
	var path := ModelLib.DIR + "characters.fbx"
	if not ResourceLoader.exists(path):
		return false
	var ps := load(path)
	if ps == null or not (ps is PackedScene):
		return false
	var inst := (ps as PackedScene).instantiate()
	if inst == null or not (inst is Node3D):
		return false
	var n := inst as Node3D
	for mi in n.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
		var mesh_instance := mi as MeshInstance3D
		if mesh_instance.name.findn("Female") >= 0:
			mesh_instance.visible = false
	_visual_root.add_child(n)
	n.rotation.y = PI
	var aabb := ModelLib._merged_aabb(n)
	if aabb.size.y > 0.01:
		var k := 1.8 / aabb.size.y
		n.scale = Vector3.ONE * k
		n.position.y = -aabb.position.y * k
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = PILOT_COLOR
	mat.roughness = 0.75
	ModelLib._paint(n, mat)
	return true


func _piece(parent: Node3D, name_v: String, size_v: Vector3, pos: Vector3,
		color: Color) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.name = name_v
	var mesh := BoxMesh.new()
	mesh.size = size_v
	mi.mesh = mesh
	mi.position = pos
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = color
	mat.roughness = 0.8
	mi.material_override = mat
	parent.add_child(mi)
	return mi


func _build_biped_fallback() -> void:
	# Deliberately humanoid, never a capsule: clean source checkout must not
	# silently regress to the VS-2 oval.
	var body := Node3D.new()
	body.name = "BipedFallback"
	_visual_root.add_child(body)
	_piece(body, "Torso", Vector3(0.62, 0.72, 0.34), Vector3(0, 1.18, 0), PILOT_COLOR)
	_piece(body, "Pelvis", Vector3(0.48, 0.28, 0.32), Vector3(0, 0.74, 0), DARK)
	var head := MeshInstance3D.new()
	head.name = "Head"
	var sphere := SphereMesh.new()
	sphere.radius = 0.19
	sphere.height = 0.38
	head.mesh = sphere
	head.position = Vector3(0, 1.72, 0)
	var hm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	hm.albedo_color = Color(0.58, 0.66, 0.70)
	head.material_override = hm
	body.add_child(head)

	_left_leg = Node3D.new()
	_right_leg = Node3D.new()
	_left_arm = Node3D.new()
	_right_arm = Node3D.new()
	_left_leg.position = Vector3(-0.16, 0.68, 0)
	_right_leg.position = Vector3(0.16, 0.68, 0)
	_left_arm.position = Vector3(-0.42, 1.42, 0)
	_right_arm.position = Vector3(0.42, 1.42, 0)
	for limb in [_left_leg, _right_leg, _left_arm, _right_arm]:
		body.add_child(limb)
	_piece(_left_leg, "LegL", Vector3(0.20, 0.72, 0.22), Vector3(0, -0.34, 0), DARK)
	_piece(_right_leg, "LegR", Vector3(0.20, 0.72, 0.22), Vector3(0, -0.34, 0), DARK)
	_piece(_left_arm, "ArmL", Vector3(0.16, 0.62, 0.18), Vector3(0, -0.27, 0), PILOT_COLOR)
	_piece(_right_arm, "ArmR", Vector3(0.16, 0.62, 0.18), Vector3(0, -0.27, 0), PILOT_COLOR)


func _build_weapon() -> void:
	var gun := Node3D.new()
	gun.name = "Rifle"
	_visual_root.add_child(gun)
	var mounted := false
	for file in ["rifle.fbx", "SM_Wep_PowerRifle_01.fbx", "SM_Wep_AssaultRifle_01.fbx"]:
		if ResourceLoader.exists(ModelLib.DIR + file):
			mounted = ModelLib.attach_sized(gun, file, DARK, Vector3(0.36, 1.20, -0.35), 0.95)
			if mounted:
				break
	if not mounted:
		_piece(gun, "RifleFallback", Vector3(0.14, 0.14, 0.86),
			Vector3(0.34, 1.22, -0.48), DARK)


func _build_pack() -> void:
	_pack = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var pb := BoxMesh.new()
	pb.size = Vector3(0.42, 0.42, 0.26)
	var pm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	pm.albedo_color = Color(0.20, 0.78, 0.38)
	pm.emission_enabled = true
	pm.emission = Color(0.03, 0.22, 0.09)
	_pack.mesh = pb
	_pack.material_override = pm
	_pack.position = Vector3(0.0, 1.15, 0.38)
	_pack.visible = false
	_visual_root.add_child(_pack)


func _build_camera() -> void:
	_pivot = Node3D.new()
	_pivot.position = Vector3(0.0, CAMERA_PIVOT_HEIGHT, 0.0)
	add_child(_pivot)
	_arm = SpringArm3D.new()
	_arm.spring_length = CAMERA_FREE_LENGTH
	_arm.margin = CAMERA_MARGIN
	_arm.position = Vector3(CAMERA_SHOULDER_X, 0.0, 0.0)
	_arm.collision_mask = 1
	_pivot.add_child(_arm)
	camera = Camera3D.new()
	camera.fov = 75.0
	camera.near = 0.08
	camera.current = false
	_arm.add_child(camera)


func _build_screen_feedback() -> void:
	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
	add_child(layer)
	_crosshair = ColorRect.new()
	_crosshair.color = AMBER
	_crosshair.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_crosshair.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER)
	_crosshair.position = Vector2(-2, -2)
	_crosshair.size = Vector2(4, 4)
	layer.add_child(_crosshair)
	_dmg_flash = ColorRect.new()
	_dmg_flash.color = Color(0.90, 0.12, 0.08, 0.0)
	_dmg_flash.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_dmg_flash.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	layer.add_child(_dmg_flash)


func set_local_camera_active(on: bool) -> void:
	if camera != null:
		camera.current = local_view and on
	if _crosshair != null:
		_crosshair.visible = local_view and on


func sync_from_avatar(body: PlayerAvatar, delta: float) -> void:
	if _pivot == null or body.pilot_input == null:
		return
	# Player body can now face travel independently in free mode. Keep the
	# presentation camera on the replicated absolute look yaw by compensating
	# for the parent's rollback-synchronized body rotation.
	_pivot.rotation.y = wrapf(body.pilot_input.look_yaw - body.rotation.y, -PI, PI)
	_pivot.rotation.x = body.pilot_input.look_pitch
	var aim := body.pilot_input.aiming
	_arm.spring_length = lerpf(_arm.spring_length,
		CAMERA_AIM_LENGTH if aim else CAMERA_FREE_LENGTH, minf(delta * 12.0, 1.0))
	camera.fov = lerpf(camera.fov, 62.0 if aim else 75.0, minf(delta * 12.0, 1.0))
	if _native != null:
		_native.sync(body.velocity, body.grounded, delta)
	_sync_fallback_walk(body.velocity, delta)


func _sync_fallback_walk(velocity: Vector3, delta: float) -> void:
	if _left_leg == null:
		return
	var speed := Vector2(velocity.x, velocity.z).length()
	_anim_t += delta * maxf(speed, 0.5) * 1.8
	var amount := clampf(speed / 7.5, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.55
	var swing := sin(_anim_t) * amount
	_left_leg.rotation.x = swing
	_right_leg.rotation.x = -swing
	_left_arm.rotation.x = -swing * 0.6
	_right_arm.rotation.x = swing * 0.6


func damage_flash() -> void:
	if _dmg_flash == null:
		return
	_dmg_flash.color = Color(0.90, 0.12, 0.08, 0.26)
	Fx.play_sfx(self, Fx.thud_stream(), -10.0, 0.82)
	get_tree().create_timer(0.12).timeout.connect(func():
		if is_instance_valid(_dmg_flash):
			_dmg_flash.color = Color(0.90, 0.12, 0.08, 0.0))


func shot_audio(hit: bool, weakpoint: bool = false) -> void:
	# Reuse the proven procedural mech SFX family; no licensed audio dependency.
	# Local fire stays immediate/non-spatial, remote pilot shots use a short 3D
	# cue so co-op preserves ownership without making every rifle sound local.
	if local_view:
		Fx.play_sfx(self, Fx.shot_stream(), -7.0, 1.12)
	else:
		_play_world_sfx(Fx.shot_stream(), -10.0, 1.04)
	if local_view and hit:
		Fx.play_sfx(self, Fx.zap_stream() if weakpoint else Fx.thud_stream(),
			-13.0 if weakpoint else -15.0, 1.18 if weakpoint else 1.0)


func _play_world_sfx(stream: AudioStream, volume_db: float, pitch: float) -> void:
	if stream == null or not is_inside_tree():
		return
	var p := AudioStreamPlayer3D.new()
	p.stream = stream
	p.volume_db = volume_db
	p.pitch_scale = pitch
	p.max_distance = 45.0
	add_child(p)
	p.play()
	p.finished.connect(p.queue_free)


func hit_feedback(weakpoint: bool = false) -> void:
	if _crosshair == null:
		return
	_crosshair.color = Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.70) if weakpoint else Color(0.24, 0.86, 0.55)
	get_tree().create_timer(0.09).timeout.connect(func():
		if is_instance_valid(_crosshair):
			_crosshair.color = AMBER)


func aim_ray() -> Array:
	if camera == null:
		return [global_position + Vector3.UP * 1.55, -global_basis.z]
	var t := camera.global_transform
	return [t.origin, -t.basis.z]


func muzzle_pos() -> Vector3:
	return to_global(Vector3(0.34, 1.22, -0.95))


func tracer(from: Vector3, to: Vector3) -> void:
	if from.distance_to(to) < 0.25 or not is_inside_tree():
		return
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var cyl := CylinderMesh.new()
	cyl.top_radius = 0.018
	cyl.bottom_radius = 0.018
	cyl.height = from.distance_to(to)
	mi.mesh = cyl
	mi.position = (from + to) * 0.5
	var dir := from.direction_to(to)
	mi.look_at(to, Vector3.UP if absf(dir.dot(Vector3.UP)) < 0.99 else Vector3.RIGHT)
	mi.rotate_object_local(Vector3.RIGHT, PI * 0.5)
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = Color(1.0, 0.84, 0.38)
	mat.emission_enabled = true
	mat.emission = Color(1.0, 0.66, 0.15)
	mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.2
	mi.material_override = mat
	var root := get_tree().current_scene
	if root == null:
		return
	root.add_child(mi)
	get_tree().create_timer(0.055).timeout.connect(mi.queue_free)

var yaw := 0.0
var pitch := 0.0
var grounded := false
var health := 100.0
var max_health := 100.0
var alive := true
var carrying_pack := false
var dodge_cd := 0.0
var dodge_left := 0.0
var fire_cd := 0.0


func packed() -> Dictionary:
	return {
		"p": [position.x, position.y, position.z],
		"v": [velocity.x, velocity.y, velocity.z],
		"yaw": yaw,
		"pitch": pitch,
		"gnd": grounded,
		"hp": health,
		"pack": carrying_pack,
	}
